english.title: Enter / leave Stansted Airport London through unauthorised gate / entrance / exit
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[entered]_
(B)_[left]_

Stansted Airport London otherwise than through a gate or

(C)_[entrance]_
(D)_[exit]_

for the time being provided by the Airport Company for that purpose
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 4(11) and 2(3) of the Stansted Airport - London Byelaws, 1996 and section 63 of the Airports Act 1986.

english.notes: This Byelaw describes an act which is prohibited unless the permission of the Airport Company has first been obtained or unless the act is performed by a person acting with lawful authority or excuse.
